Class UserInventory

java.lang.Object
com.gachapet.data.UserInventory
public class UserInventory extends Object
Manages the player's pet collection and coins. *

This class uses ArrayList<AbstractPet> to support polymorphism. It can store Cat, Dog, MythicPet, or any other subclass of AbstractPet in the same list.
